Description

Your responsibilities

Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.

What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Projects Lead - Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About Us
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The Role
As Business Operations Associate your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs. 

You will often get a question with little more than a goal attached. We trust you to figure out the rest: to structure the problem yourself and to deliver work of a high standard.
 

What You'll Do
Your main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:
 
 

• Take full ownership of company-wide projects, from scoping and planning to execution and follow-up. 

• Conduct market research and analyses, for example on new markets, crops, competitors or customer 

• segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 

• Set up and follow up on our company OKRs together with management and team leads. 

• Handle confidential information, such as financial, strategic and personnel matters, with discretion.  

As Zymofix grows, new projects will land on your desk.

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in Bioscience Engineering (bio-ingenieur). 

• You are mature and discreet, and you know how to handle confidential information. 

• You set a high standard for the work you deliver: well thought out, structured and well presented. 

• You need few instructions to deliver a strong result. You structure a problem yourself, ask the right questions and take it from there. 

• You enjoy project work and are comfortable juggling several projects at once. 

• You have strong analytical skills and can turn research and data into clear, actionable conclusions. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• A first work experience, for example in consulting or a startup environment, is a plus.

Our customer is looking for an Administrator to join the Packaging Department. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring suppliers to ensure their packaging complies with the European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Monitoring suppliers' compliance with PPWR requirements and ensuring project deadlines are achieved.
 
• Organizing and facilitating online meetings with suppliers.
 
• Advising suppliers on packaging types, responsibilities, and compliance expectations.
 
• Explaining regulatory requirements and guiding suppliers through implementation plans.
 
• Coordinating action plans and establishing clear timelines and milestones.
 
• Following up on corrective actions and tracking supplier progress.
 
• Preparing weekly compliance and progress reports for management.
 
• Escalating risks, concerns, and non-compliance issues when necessary.
 
• Conducting compliance checks and audits on packaging and manufacturer labels within warehouse operations.
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling activities comply with PPWR regulations and internal quality standards.
 
• Contributing to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain environment. 

Who are we looking for? 
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.
 
• Experience in logistics, compliance, supply chain administration, or project coordination is an asset.
 
• Knowledge of sustainable packaging solutions is considered a strong plus. 
 

 
• Fluent in English.
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Access and/or Power BI.
 
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
 
• Detail-oriented, accurate, and reliable.
 
• Capable of working independently while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues.
 
• Proactive mindset with strong follow-up skills, analytic, team-oriented, positive, handson.

PROJECT

You work within the multi-national research environment of the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Royal Military Academy. As a university, we conduct research in various technological domains, including unmanned systems, land mobility, and landmines manipulations, aimed at enhancing user comfort. Our work balances the development of novel and beneficial applications with efforts to mitigate potential risks associated with these technologies. As a military research lab, we focus on applications in public security and Defense. Examples of practical applications include ground robots for detecting and neutralizing landmines, unmanned vehicles for patrolling tough complex conditions, and studies to improve vehicle and environmental conditions.

 

In this position, you will work alongside a large team of research engineers, each leading their own projects. Your role will be to assist in the implementation of various projects, by contributing to the related electro-mechanical aspects. Given our strong involvement in European-scale collaborative projects, you will punctually prepare and follow on-site test campaigns, mainly on military test sites in Flanders, sometimes abroad.

 

WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 January  2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2030. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. However, the RMA-MECA dept has a policy to keep the good elements and this position will in any case be required beyond that date as well, so if we're happy with you there is a high chance that we will offer you a follow-up beyond that date if you decide to stay.
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);

jobs.occupation: Jet Engin Inspector | Zaventem | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Jet Engin Inspector wanted for a company in Zaventem. The company is a worldwide leader in design, development and production of aircraft engines. 

Your Responsibilities: Perform visual and dimensional inspections on dismantled parts in accordance with applicable procedures. Assess parts (serviceable, repairable, or scrap) using the ERP system and initiate necessary actions. Apply appropriate materials, tools, and methods. Ensure traceability by administratively closing completed tasks. 

Determine the future configuration of parts or modules. Conduct incoming inspections of repaired or purchased parts. 

Carry out final inspections after internal repairs.

 
• You have a superior technical secondary school degree (type A2 in Mechanics, Car Mechanics, Electromechanics...) with a strong foundation in mechanics and proven experience as an aeronautical technician, or a bachelor's degree in aviation with relevant experience in our field. 
 
• You have excellent knowledge of aircraft engines and proven experience as an Inspector. 
 
• You are stress-resistant and take responsibility 
 
• You are flexible can adapt to changing working conditions. 
 
• As an Inspector quality and safety are your priorities. 
 
• You are proactive and can take decisions in urgent situations. 
 
• You have a very good knowledge of technical English, with some knowledge of Dutch or French and you are willing to improve your skills. 
 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts (from 6am to 2pm, and from 2pm to 10pm). 
 
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and supporting your colleagues.

Requirements: 
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU passport or valid work and residence permit). 

Visa or permit assistance is not provided.
